title: concept_rerank response v0.1.0
description: Output of the AI-assisted concept-mapping reranker (Phase 3 Plan 6 / T-024A).

concept_id.description: vocab.concept.concept_id; MUST come from the input candidates list.

rationale.description: Optional one-line rationale ('exact match', 'domain mismatch demoted', etc.).

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the top-1 candidate, [0, 1]. Low confidence (<= 0.3) signals 'no good match — escalate to manual review'.

rerank_model.description: Identifier for the rerank model + prompt (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini@concept_rerank-v0.1.0').
